title: Client-stack benchmark result (one gate, one candidate, one device)
description: Evidence file spikes/bench/results/<candidate>/<device>/<gate>.json (gates.yaml rules.evidence). Numeric gates carry raw samples and a gated value; hard gates carry a human verdict. Semantic rules that JSON Schema cannot express (percentile recomputation, pass == value <= threshold, thresholds copied from gates.yaml, path/field agreement, pinned versions per candidate) are checked by spikes/bench/validate_results.py.

candidate.description: Candidate id from gates.yaml candidates (gpui-kit, flutter, hybrid), or example for illustrative files.

device.description: gates.yaml device key (iphone, android, desktop_linux, desktop_macos). The example file uses linux.

device_model.description: Hardware model as reported by the device (e.g. iPhone15,2, Pixel 8, Lenovo ThinkPad X1). Use unknown only when it cannot be read; record why in notes.

os_version.description: OS name and version (e.g. iOS 19.1, Android 16 API 36, Ubuntu 24.04 kernel 6.18).

pinned.description: Versions the number is valid for (gates.yaml rules.version_pin). Which keys are required depends on the candidate; see validate_results.py.

gpui_rev.description: gpui crate pin, e.g. gpui-pre@0.3.10 (crates.io version; the root Cargo.toml pins it by version, not git rev).

gpui_component_rev.description: gpui-component git rev (40 hex chars), root Cargo.toml.

gate.description: gates.yaml numeric or hard gate id.

unit.description: ms, s or MB for numeric gates (gates.yaml); pass_fail for hard gates.

threshold.description: The gates.yaml max for this device (numeric). null for hard gates.

statistic.description: How value is derived. median_of_run_p95: median over runs of each run's p95 (frame time, key-to-glyph; samples are pooled raw values). median_of_runs: median of samples, one sample per run (cold start, RSS). single: one measurement (binary size). verdict: hard gates.

value.description: The number compared with threshold (numeric), per statistic. null for hard gates.

samples.description: Raw samples in unit. Numeric: frame or key-to-glyph values pooled over all runs, or one value per run, or one value. Hard gates: empty.

p50.description: Nearest-rank 50th percentile of samples (pooled). null for hard gates.

p95.description: Nearest-rank 95th percentile of samples (pooled). null for hard gates.

runs.description: Per-run summaries (numeric gates with several runs). p95 is the run's own nearest-rank p95 of its raw values.

pass.description: Numeric: value <= threshold. Hard: the human verdict (true only if every step in HARD_GATES.md passed).

checked_by.description: Hard gates: who ran the check (role and name or handle).

evidence.description: Repo-relative paths to raw logs, screen recordings or screenshots backing the result.

notes.description: Workload, renderer, build profile, known deviations from the procedure.
